summary: Guest onboarding approval stuck 'Awaiting Provision' after Okta SSO redirect — cross-project tool access blocked
description: Issue summary: A contractor (guest) attempted to accept an access invite and complete onboarding for the Feature Flags admin role. The request is stuck in the internal access-provisioner UI with status 'Awaiting Provision'. Customer-facing behavior: the guest sees 'Provisioning pending' for >30 minutes and cannot access any cross-project tools (console, dashboard). Impact: Blocks delivery for a contractor performing time-sensitive QA; affects only guests onboarded via Okta invite flow in prod-us-east. Observed symptoms point to a session affinity breakdown between identity-proxy and access-provisioner after an Okta redirect retry.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create guest invite via Admin Console -> Invitations -> New guest (uses Okta SSO). 2) Guest receives invite link, clicks and is redirected to Okta for authentication. 3) After Okta, guest is redirected back via identity-proxy which should set session and callback to access-provisioner. 4) In affected runs, the redirect chain triggers a second identity-proxy retry (302) that sets a different session cookie path, leaving the provisioner without the expected session token. 5) Access-provisioner shows 'Awaiting Provision' indefinitely.
logs: identity-proxy logs (prod-us-east) show repeated 302->302 redirect for /sso/callback with different Set-Cookie headers: session_id=abc; Path=/; SameSite=Lax and then session_id=def; Path=/auth; SameSite=None; Secure. access-provisioner logs show missing session token for 00:12:43-00:13:10 UTC. Okta audit shows successful SAML assertion at 00:12:42 UTC. No 5xx errors from provisioner. Relevant request IDs: req-9f8a1b, req-9f8a1c. UI trace: ticket creation -> invite consumed -> provisioner pending - see screenshot attached in ticket (link).
comments: 2026-03-10 12:45 — Asha Patel: Guest reported provision step never completed; forwarded initial logs and screenshot. Escalated to SRE for session affinity hypothesis.

2026-03-10 13:02 — Diego Morales (SRE): Observed double-set-cookie scenario in identity-proxy during replay of the flow. Hypothesis: recent edge deploy changed cookie path normalization. Assigning to identity-proxy owner to confirm.

2026-03-10 15:30 — Mira Chen (Identity Proxy Owner): Reproduced locally with synthetic invite flow. When Okta redirects include SP-initiated retry query param, proxy rewrites path and issues secondary cookie. Creating quick patch to prefer first cookie and normalize path.

2026-03-11 09:10 — Diego Morales: Applied hotfix to identity-proxy in prod-us-east (release id: rel-2026-03-11-identity-proxy-1). Observed provisioning proceed normally for 3 test invites. Rolling to 100% after 30m observation window.
2026-03-12 08:55 — Contractor (external): Confirms they were able to accept invite after clearing browser cookies; now has access. Marking as in-progress while monitoring.
2026-03-12 11:00 — Diego Morales: Added follow-up action items to update runbook and add automated E2E test for Okta redirect-retry path.
investigation_notes: Initial triage focused on provisioner but logs showed no internal errors. Correlated identity-proxy traces with Okta audit; timing indicates successful assertion but the session token presented to access-provisioner did not match expected cookie name. Reproduced by toggling 'force-redirect-retry' flag in Okta test app which triggered a second Set-Cookie. Root cause likely a recent proxy change that started issuing a second cookie when path normalization encountered query parameters introduced by IdP retries. Confirmed root cause by replaying production headers in staging. Dashboards: auth-cookie-mismatch-rate spiked at 2026-03-10T12:30:00Z in us-east. No related deploys to access-provisioner in the window. Associated PR for fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/1427
resolution_notes: Hotfix rolled to prod-us-east identity-proxy (rel-2026-03-11-identity-proxy-1) which stops emitting the second cookie on SP-initiated retries and normalizes cookie Path to '/'. Confirmed 12 successful guest onboarding flows during 1h post-deploy. Workaround for existing stuck invites: support can manually clear stale session cookies by triggering 're-invite' or instruct guest to clear browser cookies and re-open invite link. Follow-ups: 1) Add regression E2E for Okta redirect-retry scenario (task INT-123999). 2) Update guest-onboarding runbook with cookie-clear troubleshooting steps. 3) Plan a config flag to enforce single-session semantics across proxies. Post-incident owner: Mira Chen. Pending: automated alert to detect cookie-mismatch spike (SRE monitoring ticket created).
